eider: Any species of sea duck of the genus Somateria, esp. Somateria mollissima, which breeds in the northern parts of Europe and America, and lines its nest with fine down (taken from its own body) which is an article of commerce; -- called also eider duck. eisteddfod: Am assembly or session of the Welsh bards; an annual congress of bards, minstrels and literati of Wales, -- being a patriotic revival of the old custom.
eighteenth: 1. Next in order after the seventeenth. 2. Consisting of one of eighteen equal parts or divisions of a thing. | 1. The quotient of a unit divided by eighteen; one of eighteen equal parts or divisions. 2. The eighth after the tenth.
eightling: A compound or twin crystal made up of eight individuals.
eightieth: 1. The next in order after seventy-ninth. 2. Consisting of one of eighty equal parts or divisions. | The quotient of a unit divided by eighty; one of eighty equal parts.
eikonogen: The sodium salt of a sulphonic acid of a naphthol, C10H5(OH)(NH2)SO3Na used as a developer.
eikosane: A solid hydrocarbon, C20H42, of the paraffine series, of artificial production, and also probably occurring in petroleum.
eighty: 1. The sum of eight times ten; eighty units or objects. 2. A symbol representing eighty units, or ten eight times repeated, as 80 or lxxx.
eidograph: An instrument for copying drawings on the same or a different scale; a form of the pantograph.
eigne: 1. (Law) Eldest; firstborn. Blackstone. 2. Entailed; belonging to the eldest son. (old) Bastard eigne, a bastard eldest son whose parents afterwards intermarry.
eight: An island in a river; an ait. (old) "Osiers on their eights." Evelyn. | Seven and one; as, eight years.
eighteen: Eight and ten; as, eighteen pounds. | 1. The number greater by a unit than seventeen; eighteen units or objects. 2. A symbol denoting eighteen units, as 18 or xviii.
eighth: 1. Next in order after the seventh. 2. Consisting of one of eight equal divisions of a thing. Eighth note (Mus.), the eighth part of a whole note, or semibreve; a quaver. | 1. The quotient of a unit divided by eight; one of eight equal parts; an eighth part. 2. (Mus.) The interval of an octave.
either: 1. One of two; the one or the other; -- properly used of two things, but sometimes of a larger number, for any one. Lepidus flatters both, Of both is flattered; but he neither loves, Nor either cares… | precedes two, or more, coördinate words or phrases, and is introductory to an alternative. eikosylene: A liquid hydrocarbon, C20H38, of the acetylene series, obtained from brown coal.
eirenarch: A justice of the peace; irenarch.
eikon: An image or effigy; -- used rather in an abstract sense, and rarely for a work of art.
eightscore: Eight times twenty; a hundred and sixty.
eidolon: An image or representation; a form; a phantom; an apparition. Sir W. Scott.
